title: Interleaved auxiliary frames corrupt tool JSON envelope under proxy coalescing
creator: Riley Chen
description: Several enterprise customers reported that structured JSON envelopes returned by tool/function invocations are intermittently corrupted when traffic passes through intermediate proxies that perform buffering/coalescing and retries. Corruption includes duplicated keys, shifted field values, and injection of auxiliary log/ack chunks into the envelope, causing downstream parsers to fail. Observed across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments under moderate concurrency.
reproduction_steps: 1) Configure a multi-part tool invocation (streaming response, tool metadata + payload frames)
2) Route requests through a test proxy that simulates buffering and coalescing with transient retry behavior (simulate 50-250ms retry window)
3) Issue concurrent invocations at 20-50 RPS with small chunk sizes (64-512 bytes) and intermittent auxiliary frames (ack/logs) emitted during payload
4) Observe reassembled response: check for duplicated top-level keys, field shifts, or interleaved non-envelope frames that break JSON parse
impact_summary: Breaks integrations that expect strict, single-JSON envelopes for tool results. Customers see parser exceptions, fallback behavior, or incorrect tooling outputs. Reported by three production customers (two Hosted, one Private); caused SE escalations and temporary feature degradation.
initial_triage: 2026-03-01: SE/Support triage call; hypothesis: proxy coalescing + streaming multiplexer reassembly bug
2026-03-02: Temporary mitigation: gateway toggle to disable stream coalescing for invocations for affected tenants; error rate reduced ~90% for one customer
2026-03-03: Lab reproduction with internal proxy harness; confirmed interleaving occurs when auxiliary frames emitted concurrently and reassembly merges frames out-of-order
mitigation_applied: Gateway config: tenant-scoped disable of stream coalescing for function invocations (rolled to Hosted; available for Dedicated/Private via ops playbook)
SDK advisory: provided temporary SDK patch that performs top-level schema validation and retries on parse failures for affected customers
Customer communication: SE sent mitigation steps and timeline to impacted accounts
proposed_fix: Add per-frame logical sequence tags in streaming multiplexer and enforce strict ordering during reassembly in the runtime kernel
Harden parser to ignore non-envelope auxiliary frames until envelope start detected; provide strict vs tolerant modes configurable per tenant
Add deterministic e2e tests in CI that exercise proxy coalescing, retries, and randomized delays across Hosted/Dedicated/Private
rollout_plan: Canary: runtime-2.4.1-canary to 5% Hosted traffic for 48 hours; monitor parsing.failure_rate and latency
Staged: Offer operator opt-in rollout to Dedicated customers with migration checklist and support window
Private: Release bundle and Ops runbook for on-prem customers; provide backport hotfix for supported older runtimes
qa_criteria: Deterministic reassembly under synthetic proxy harness across randomized delays and coalescing patterns
No regression in token latency >3% at p95 for standard workloads
Unit and integration test coverage for parser tolerant and strict modes
Successful validation against customer-mirror environments used by SE team
monitoring_and_metrics: Dashboard: parse failures, reassembly reorder counts, gateway coalescing toggles, per-tenant spikes
Alert: >5 parse failures/min for any paying tenant triggers on-call page and paging policy
